run_evaluate_cli: run the evaluate.py CLI module to evaluate a trained model against a dataset using a serialization directory
test_evaluate_function: test the evaluate function that runs a model forward pass on test instances and returns metrics
review_evaluate_function: review the evaluate function that iterates over dataset batches, computes loss, and aggregates metrics
summarize_main_block: summarize the main block that loads config, tasks, vocabulary, model, and runs multi-task evaluation
run_evaluate_multi_task: run multi-task evaluation by loading best epoch weights and evaluating all tasks on test data
